name: Fix app routing for desktop/mobile modes
description:
# Summary

This conversation reviewed and fixed all open app actions in the Codx Junior UI store (`src/store/ui.js`) to properly handle desktop vs mobile routing modes. The analysis identified 10 app actions (`openProjects`, `openTeams`, `openTeamChannel`, `openTeamDM`, `openTeamMediaLibrary`, `openVibeCoding`, `openTasks`, `openWiki`, `openMediaLibrary`, and `openTutorial`) that lacked proper mobile routing or had inconsistent implementations. The fix standardized all actions to follow the established pattern: in desktop mode they use `showApp()` to display as app panels, while in mobile mode they either use `setActiveTab()` for internal sidebar views or `$router.push()` for full-page navigation. Additionally, two typos in the `openMediaLibrary` action were corrected (`tgabId` → `key`, `compotabIdnent` → `component`). The updated code ensures consistent user experience across all device sizes and app contexts.
